items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: That's kind of like the old Goodman brass section, Chris Griffin, Zig Elman and Harry James.

ctx.x: That's kind of like the old Goodman brass section, Chris Griffin, Zig Elman and Harry James. The parts were divided up pretty equally, first parts.

I have -- thanks to your son, Teddy, I have a tape of most of those things you did in that era -- recorded. It's just precious to hear. They're timeless. They're timeless, they're like John Kirby's records.
